title: Small Steps Still Move You Forward | A Discipline Short Film
lines: The mountain looks impossible from here.
So he stops looking at the mountain.
He looks at the next step. Just one.
Small steps don't look like progress. Until you turn around.
One percent better. Every single day.
The distance doesn't care how slowly you walk. It only cares that you don't stop.
Keep stacking the days. The summit is just a pile of small steps.
Day thirteen. Take the next step.
